item.title: Implement retry delay spec and boundary tests
item.brief: Implement retry_budget.py according to SPEC.md. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, add focused tests beyond existing basics, use only the Python standard library. Validate all arguments (built-in int excluding bool; nonnegative constraints and positive attempt/max_attempts) before any exhaustion checks. Implement efficient saturated exponential backoff, uncapped Retry-After minimum, strict budget boundary. Run focused tests and commit the work as requested; repository is local ship mode, so commit locally. Acceptance: all spec clauses covered by implementation and focused tests, existing tests pass.

pr.body: Implemented the pure retry_delay API in retry_budget.py and added focused validation and boundary coverage in test_retry_budget.py. Validation rejects bool, float and negative values before exhaustion checks. Backoff handles zero base/cap and huge attempts without constructing enormous powers; Retry-After is an uncapped minimum. Full unittest discovery and diff whitespace checks passed. Assumption: the repository's unittest discovery is its full test suite; no build or linter configuration is present.
